articleTitle: Interval difference operator for the task of identification recurrent laryngeal nerve
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper, the mathematical model in form of the interval difference operator (IDO) is considered. The model was used for visualization and identification of the recurrent laryngeal nerve on the tissue of the surgery wound. A method for structure identification of the IDO is proposed.

articleTitle: Reliability models of electric machines with structural defects
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Particular features of solving the problem of forecasting the reliability of electric machines with long mean time between failures by means of taking into account the state of their basic structural units are considered. The prospect of using mathematical variable-structure reliability models based on joint use of fuzzy logic and neural network provisions is grounded for solution of this problem. It allows taking into consideration the influence of informative parameters characterizing the state of structural units and the environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Compensation of higher current harmonics at harmonic distortions of mains supply voltage
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The processes of higher current harmonic compensation in a power-supply system at harmonic distortions of mains supply voltage have been investigated. A method for elimination of mains supply voltage harmonic distortions' influence on operation of an active power Alter by means of exclusion of corresponding harmonics from the algorithm of compensation current calculation has been proposed.

articleTitle: Intelligent recurrent-and-parallel computing for solving inductive modeling problems
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The idea of combined use of recurrent and parallel computing in combinatorial GMDH algorithm is investigated. Intelligent technology of inductive modeling on the basis of recurrent-and-parallel computing is developed. Its effectiveness is experimentally examined using a multiprocessor cluster system.

articleTitle: Features of an eLearning software for teaching and self-studying of electrical engineering
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the experience in developing an electronic textbook titled "Fundamentals of the theory of electronic circuits" has been summarized. A concept of development principles for electronic textbook is presented. The procedure of assessment and evaluation of knowledge is described in details. An algorithm for automatic task verification with help of a formula entry has been developed.

articleTitle: Comparison of DFIG and SEF-DFIG operation in wind turbine systems
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Recently, the idea of a variable speed wind turbine equipped with doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) has obtained great regard because of its considerable superiority over other wind turbine generators. New configuration of DFIG is single external feeding of DFIG (SEF-DFIG) where a rotor side converter (RSC) is set instead of the back to back variable frequency converter (VFC) in the conventional DFIG. In this paper, the vector control method for the SEF-DFIG is defined, then DFIG and SEF-DFIG operation in wind turbine system (WTS) during normal condition and grid fault, is compared. Also a static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is employed to supply the reactive power and voltage support to a wind turbine equipped with conventional DFIG and SEF-DFIG and power system during normal grid condition and grid faults. Simulation has been done using PSCAD/EMTDC software.

Author Keywords: single external feeding doubly fed induction generator (SEF-DFIG)

articleTitle: Positivity and stability of discrete-time and continuous-time nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The positivity and asymptotic stability of the discrete-time and continuous-time nonlinear systems are addressed. Sufficient conditions for the positivity and asymptotic stability of the nonlinear systems are established. The proposed stability tests are based on an extension of the Lyapunov method to the positive nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control law of electrode travel in arc steelmaking furnace
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A combined law of the control signal creation for arc steel melting furnace electrodes moving based on the principle of fuzzy control and the system structure for its implementation are proposed.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the current density distribution in a high-frequency electrosurgery
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: An important goal of surgical exposure is a fusion of living tissues. The electric welding Institute (PWI) developed the method of welding of soft tissues. Method of welding provides reliability of connection without the use of suture. The developed mathematical model can be applied for rectangular conductors with different conductivity in a wide frequency range.

articleTitle: Estimation of supercapacitor efficiency in use for resistance welding
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The appearing of supercapacitor internal resistance influence on efficiency of energy delivery in resistance welding circuit was studied in the paper. The dependencies of supercapacitor energy storage efficiency on load resistance were obtained. The limits of supercapacitor use for resistance welding area were determined.

articleTitle: Synthesis of automatic control systems by a particle swarm optimization method using butterworth fractional standard forms
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The approach to the synthesis of fractional controllers for automatic control systems circuits by a particle swarm optimization method has been proposed. Novelty of this approach lies in the idea that one is supposed to choose the desired quality of the transition process by the parameters of one of the standard fractional Butterworth forms. The paper considers two variants of the controller parameters synthesis by a particle swarm optimization: using the transition function of desired standard fractional form; using the characteristic points of transition function of desired standard fractional form.

articleTitle: Application of linear AR and ARMA processes for simulation of power equipment diagnostic systems information signals
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A new approach to statistical simulation of the information signals that can be described mathematically by linear stochastic processes is presented. The paper contains some knowledge of the Linear Stochastic Process Theory, a modelling processes classification, and discusses a method of simulation problems solving in the case when the mean and jumps spectrum of the process being simulated is given. The simulation of linear autoregressive processes is considered as an example of the proposed method usage.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of processes in asynchronous motors with capacitors connected in series
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The mathematical model of an asynchronous motor with capacitors connected in series that allows investigating the influence of capacitance value on the motor startup has been developed. The article presents the results of mathematical modeling.

articleTitle: An assessment of accuracy of approximate mathematical model of pulse electromagnetic field of current flowing near conductive body
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: An assessment of accuracy of asymptotic method for analysis of a three-dimensional pulse electromagnetic field created by arbitrary current contour, which is located near the flat surface of a conductive body, has been considered. Comparison of the exact and approximate values of integrand function for exponentially damped impulse has shown correspondence of theoretical estimations for asymptotic series' terms and calculation results.

articleTitle: Newly developed method of signal-to-noise ratio estimation
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the problem of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimation in communication, telemetry and radar systems.

articleTitle: Increasing of the correctness of mathematical models by novel reduction principle
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the principle how to detect and eliminate the redundant elements in the mathematical model is presented. The efficiency of the proposed approach has been analyzed based on the neural network model of economic system. Results has proved the 16 times increasing of the model accuracy.

articleTitle: Magnetic field of a shielded three-phase busbar system
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents the measurement results of the magnetic field in a shielded three-phase busbar system manufactured by Holduct Mysłowice. The measurements were performed with use of a specific non-directional magnetic field probe. In addition, also theoretical computations were done with use of finite elements. The results roughly agree, but at some probing points the differences are considerable, probably due to inaccurate positioning the probe between the bus bars.

articleTitle: Anisotropic properties of electrical steels
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Anisotropy is an important phenomenon, which should be taken into account by the designers of magnetic circuits in electrical machines. Even the so-called non-oriented (dynamo) steels feature significant anisotropy. It is thus essential to work out new analytical methods and mathematical models, which may be easily implemented in CAD routines. The paper describes one of possible approaches to address the problem. The results of model prediction are compared to available measurement data for chosen grades of non-oriented and grain-oriented steels.

articleTitle: Simulation of discharge capacity axle symmetric systems "coil — Non-ferromagnetic massive disk" by the method of integral equations
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Axisymmetric model of transient processes in the RLC circuit with the influence of eddy currents induced in the massive disk by current in the coil L that is located coaxially with it based on transformation the boundary problem for Maxwell's equations to the equivalent integral equation for the eddy currents density and its subsequent joint solution with the equation circuit for the discharge circuit that allows you to calculate interaction force of currents in the coil L and the eddy currents in a massive disk.

Author Keywords: eddy current method of integral equations

articleTitle: Application of superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) in electric power grids
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Application of SMES for solving problems of reliable, stable and effective work of electric power grids is investigated. The main advantages of using SMES are shown by comparison with traditional safety instruments of energy systems. The toroidal magnetic systems with support system inside torus and different shape of coils are analyzed.

articleTitle: High-speed power system stability analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper Z-transform based on pole/zero matching method is proposed for high-speed computer simulation of electromagnetic transients in power systems with the purpose of their stability analysis. The application of Z-transform method is illustrated on example of simple electrical circuit.

articleTitle: Mathematical model for investigation of wave processes in high-voltage two-winding transformers
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A mathematical model intended for research of wave processes in high-voltage two-windings transformers was developed. The variable separation method was used to solve the integral-differential equations describing the process under research. The voltage distribution in the transformer windings under the influence of the impulse overvoltages was analyzed.

articleTitle: The comparison of electric field perturbations by water inclusions in linear and nonlinear XLPE insulation
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The mathematical modeling results of low-frequency electric field inhomogeneous distribution and the total current density in the high-voltage polyethylene insulation with water micro-inclusions has been performed. The comparison of calculations results for linear and nonlinear problem formulation has been made. The evaluation of solid insulation degradation in strong electric fields has been performed.

articleTitle: 3D magnetic filed distribution in a screw double-stator induction motor
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper Ansys Maxwell calculation result of 3D magnetic field in a double-stator screw induction motor with hollow outer ferromagnetic rotor is given.

articleTitle: The calculation of the magnetic field in the working area of the linear motor with permanent magnets
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the mathematical model intended for calculation of the magnetic field in the working area of the coaxial linear motor with permanent magnets is developed.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Fast Fourier Transform implementations on GPU and CPU
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper, we present the results of comparison of the effectiveness of selected variants of radix-2 Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms implemented on both Graphics (GPU) and Central (CPU) Processing Units. The considered algorithms differ in memory consumption and the arrangement of data-flow paths which affects the global memory coalescing and cache memory exploitation. The obtained results allow to indicate the variants of FFT algorithms which are best suited for GPU and CPU architectures, to confirm the advisability of GPU oriented calculations of FFT and to formulate a guideline for implementations of fast algorithms of various linear transforms.

articleTitle: Correlation theory of random processes in problems concerning power systems with electric transport
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A new method is proposed for determining the energy indices in electric transport systems, based on the correlation theory of random processes. According to this method, the components of apparent power and power factor are expressed through correlation functions and mathematical expectations of investigated traction voltages and currents. Numerical calculations of active, reactive and apparent power as well as the ratio of reactive power for a traction substation feeder show that the method possesses high accuracy: the error is less than 2%.

articleTitle: Induction motor electromechanical quantities estimation based on the inductance frequency characteristic — Simulation studies
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The estimation methodology of electromechanical quantities of an induction motor has been presented in the paper. The investigated estimation algorithms are based on the motor inductance frequency characteristic and the machine secondary multi-loop equivalent circuit, reproducing this characteristic in the analyzed frequency range. The conducted simulation studies indicate the possibility of using the proposed algorithms in an estimation process of considered electromechanical quantities of an induction motor.

articleTitle: Methods of spectral analysis of traction voltages and currents as random functions
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper shows the methods of spectral analysis of stochastic traction voltages and currents. The results of analysis are shown for the voltage, which has been recorded in the process of real operation of EPL2T electric multiple-unit train.

articleTitle: Investigation of stability reserve of linear periodically-time-variable circuits by the frequency symbolic method
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper the questions concerning estimation of stability reserve of linear periodically-time-variable circuits are investigated with the help of frequency symbolic analysis and approximation of a transfer function by a Fourier polynomial. The appropriate calculation is carried out by means of the system of MAOPC-functions.

articleTitle: Open access system for radiotherapy planning
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The recent trends in software development transform classical desktop-based programs into distributed systems offered over the Internet. The authors adapt this approach to the radiotherapy planning software. A general concept and necessary components of such a system are presented.

articleTitle: Development of technology of through planning of electric power distribution systems based on consistent informative model
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The informative model of power distribution systems of industrial objects is created based on ontology in order to apply it to the intellectual CAD systems. Formalization of process how to plan the electric power distribution systems on the basis of behavior trees using the consistent informative model was carried out.

Author Keywords: electric power distribution system common data model

articleTitle: Location of open conductor failure combined with phase-to-earth fault on power line
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: One-end algorithm for locating an open conductor failure combined with an earth fault on power lines has been presented. Two cases: an open conductor failure occurring in front of and behind a earth fault, respectively, have been considered. The sample case with the fault data obtained from ATP-EMTP simulation is included and discussed.

articleTitle: Sensitivity method for evaluating impact of accuracy of the measurement path during ESD generator verification
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper contains results of uncertainty estimation during verification of ESD generator parameters by means of sensitivity method in scattering parameters measurement. In addition, basic assumptions and limitations necessary for correct measurement those parameters were described. A calculation example as well as simulation results and graphs have been presented.

articleTitle: The optimization of energy parameters of the electrical systems of charge of supercapacitor from accumulator battery
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The research is devoted to comparison of energy characteristics of linear capacitor and super-capacitor during their charge from the accumulator battery. The features of influence of the final voltages on the electrical energy losses at charge linear capacitors from the accumulator battery and supercapacitors are established. The conditions of decrease of the losses in the capacitor charging circuits are defined.

articleTitle: Permanent magnets generator — Asymmetrical mode of operation
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Electromagnetic circuit of three-phase permanent magnet generator is presented in the paper. This generator works in one-phase operation mode. Field-circuital computational model is shown together with its cross-section. Comparative analysis of calculation results is given, for generator operating with single-phase-load, in one-phase mode when generator windings are connected in series, with three-phase asymmetrical load and three-phase symmetrical load. The waveforms of phase voltages, currents and electromagnetic torque for different load conditions are presented.

articleTitle: Features of determination of the acceleration of different dynamic microobjects by the television scanning optical microscope
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Determination of the acceleration of the dynamic microobjects movement, the motion of which is accelerated uniformly or non-uniformly is an important task in television measuring systems. Most of existing measurement systems usually have a small range of determination of the acceleration with a short period of growth.

articleTitle: Verilog-AMS model of mechanical component of integrated angular velocity microsensor for schematic design level
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Verilog-AMS model of mechanical module of integrated angular velocity microsensor has been developed. Using the developed model the drive and sense vibrations of the sensitive element, capacity changes, changes of output voltages and currents, and sensitivity of the mechanical component of the integrated microsensor depending on the applied angular velocity can be performed. The behavioral analysis of the mechanical component of the integrated device at the schematic design level can be carried out as well.

articleTitle: Study of biological tissues variability modeling
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Electrical properties of biological tissues can be described using statistical approach, which is close to the complexity of the living bodies. Application of fuzzy sets theory allows to build more realistic models of human body. In this paper two types of variability of conductivity are presented and analyzed. One related with measurement uncertainty and random distribution of parameter inside the organ, and the second with variability between individuals.

articleTitle: Subpixel processing of digital images obtained with CCD matrix
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The methods of signal analysis of photosensitive array and related conventional methods of digital filtering of time series is essentially the same as those in other areas of science and technology. Subpixel processing are peculiar, perhaps, only the inverse filtering procedure, providing high resolution of single reflections with limited pixel size photosensitive matrix. Combination of two matrix counts shifted by half a pixel, followed by deconvolution, resolution can increase in two times.

articleTitle: Complex estimation of electronics quality
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper options for quantitative estimation of electronics quality by means of one-dimensional and two-dimensional probability density functions of parameters are discussed. A mathematical apparatus for estimation of reliability of the elements of their parametric synthesis applying the models "parameter - tolerance range" and "load - load-bearing capacity of a structure" has been proposed.

articleTitle: The advantages of the hybrid laboratory work on electrical engineering
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The peculiarities of a hybrid laboratory work on electrical engineering are discussed in the article. Its main advantages determined on the experience gained in the specialized laboratory of theoretical and general electrical engineering are also represented here. This approach provides the performance of physical and virtual experiments with the use of modern technical devices and software for modeling of electromagnetic processes.

articleTitle: Accelerated calculation of steady states processes in complex nonlinear circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the computation method of time dependences of steady state processes in nonlinear circuits is proposed. The peculiarity of the method is that the calculation of time dependence of stationary process is reduced to solution of the algebraic equations system. During this process the properties of periodicity of the solution are taken into account.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the three-phase high-voltage cable lines under the theory of multiterminal networks
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article describes the methodological foundations of modelling of high-voltage cable lines in phase coordinates on the basis of the theory of multiterminal networks. The methods of constructing a mathematical model, the choice of their structure and the calculation of the model parameters are given. An example of the use and study of the mathematical model are given in the application package MATLAB.

articleTitle: Construction and practical application peculiarities of systems for power facilities remote monitoring and diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper the construction and practical application peculiarities of systems for energy facilities remote monitoring and diagnostics are considered.

articleTitle: Control of transistors in AC voltage PWM controller with elimination of commutation overvoltages
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Method of controlling transistors in ac voltage PWM controller aimed at eliminating commutation overvoltages in RL-type load circuit is proposed in the paper. The method is based upon keeping continuity of load current; this is achieved by appropriate control of transistors on the basis of detecting voltage sign (polarity) at the supply terminal and detecting load current sign (polarity). This type of control does not depend on character of the load and it makes possible increase of converter's efficiency by elimination of RC circuits protecting transistors from overvoltages. The scheme of main circuit is shown as well as waveforms demonstrating the control principle. Four different characteristic operating conditions are discussed and illustrated with simulation results. Measurements have been run to verify the method with real 3-phase ac controller and results of these tests are presented.

articleTitle: Methods for optimization of energy exchange modes between linear and nonlinear capacitors
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The methods for optimization of energy exchange between the linear and nonlinear capacitors are proposed. As an example we consider the equivalent circuit of the supercapacitor, electric capacity of which changes proportionally to the voltage on its plates. It is shown that the electric power losses in the energy exchange depend on the ratio of the value of capacitors and the initial voltage of their plates.

articleTitle: Brush-less motor for wheel's drive in multisectional city tram
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A switched reluctance motor with buffer of energy for the direct wheel's drive for multiple sectional city trams is offered in paper. Such motors will successfully compete with traction engine by satisfactory mechanical and control characteristics, higher index of reliability and less volume of active part. Recommendations based on the features of construction and on the theory of electromagnetic transformation of energy is a fundament of conducted calculation. The results of researches testify that it is possible to use these motors in the direct wheel's drive for tram.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of dynamical system with variable coefficients and fuzzy controller
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper a dynamical system with variable coefficients is considered. For it a subset of subsystems is constructed. Each subsystem is obtained via Tailor series expansion. For each subsystem a desired control is synthesized. To synthesis control of the total system fuzzy logic controller is used. Stability analysis of investigated system is held.

articleTitle: Method of refining of document relevance in search engines based on a user's local behavioral description
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Huge information content in the World Wide Web leads to redundancy of search result that can reach hundred thousands of pages. Due to this an end user sometimes finds necessary materials not in the top ten links. Method of local refining of document relevance is proposed in the paper. The proposed method is based on user's local behavioral description. Its main module comprises collecting the data from user's Web-surfing and monitoring the Web-resources retrieved in response to her/his web search query which are the most interesting for the user. Local search results are grounded on the base search engine results page and keyword search query. The research results indicate the 15% increase in search results quality.

articleTitle: The optimization of power supply modes of induction melting apparatus with a total metal draining
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The criteria of optimal control of capacity of compensation capacitors in power supply systems of installations of induction melting of metals with a full unloading their liquid phase. The technique of improving productivity and energy efficiency of such induction systems is proved.

articleTitle: Optimization method for harmonic identification in three-phase four-wire systems
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The optimization approach to voltage harmonic elimination is presented. The parallel filter used for the voltage shape improving in three-phase four wire systems is considered. The nonlinear inductor is applied as a source of current and voltage harmonics. Two cases are considered-harmonic reduction and unbalanced load correction.

articleTitle: The influence of parameters of evolutionary selection of model form on its precision and complexity
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: An automated construction of mathematical models of nonlinear dynamical systems based on optimization and evolutionary algorithms is considered. The dependency of the model quality from the parameters of evolutionary model form selection is a subject of the research. The criteria for optimal evolutionary parameters selection are proposed.

articleTitle: Log-periodic antenna — The comparison of different simulation models
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper describes and compares three numerical models of small log-periodic dipole antenna, able to operate in wide band of frequencies. The experiments were performed in ANSYS HFSS, FEKO and NEC-2 simulation packages. The most important results are briefly compared.

articleTitle: Electronic current transformer gapped sensor design parameters calculation and selection
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Basic theoretical propositions which constitute the basis for technique of calculation of electromagnetic system parameters of sensor of protective electronic current transformer with standardized metrological performance under power system transient conditions have been developed. Compliance of metrological performance of sensor with calculated parameters with its value given in calculation was confirmed by simulation modeling.

articleTitle: An alternative approach to determination of the S-parameters of noncoaxial devices
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Non-coaxial (non-insertable) devices are indispensable by EMC testing. Absorbing clamps belong to them. They are verified with the Vector Network Analyzers (VNA) which unfortunately have coaxial ports. The clamp can be connected to the VNA only if it is embedded in adapters. By verification the clamp must be de-embedded i.e. the contribution of adapters must be extracted from the measured S-parameters. The Thru-Reflect-Line (TRL) calibration of the VNA would be suitable tool for this task, but this function is only optional in the firmwares of the VNAs. In this paper the alternative approach consisted in calibration with the Short-Open-Thru-Match (SOTM), supplemented with the measurements of all S-parameters of the two adapters cascaded face to face is presented. Applicability of the method is verified metrologically.

articleTitle: Active and passive co-energy
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper the integral expressions of kinetic co-energy end potential energy for non-linear media are presented. On this base the nature of kinetic co-energy and its transformation in the act of motion into kinetic energy as a force action are shown. Such type transformation may be both active (electromagnetic field) and passive (relativity gravitation).

articleTitle: Analytical and numerical techniques for research of bifurcation processes in an electrical circuit with a laser-arc discharge
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Special techniques have been developed and bifurcation processes in nonlinear circuit with laser-arc discharge and inertial feedback was investigated. It was found that Hopf bifurcation can be both supercritical and subcritical. The boundary between the two types of bifurcation has been found. The interaction of Hopf bifurcation with other ones (the bifurcation of the twin limit cycle and bifurcation of saddle separatrix) was described.

articleTitle: Icing sensor on the overhead powerlines wires
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In systems intended for icing diagnosis on overhead power lines in exploitation conditions the imperfect icing sensors are used on their wires. Their parameters are different from parameters of controlled wires. The construction of icing sensor was developed based on overhead power lines with uninsulated wires of A, AC types. The threshold values of the ohmic resistance of the sensor were determined for two types of ice-hoarfrost sediments: rime and ice. It is proved that sensor length may be reduced and precision of measurement will be the same. It can be achieved by increasing of the subsidiary electrodes number at equality of central angles between them. It is proposed to use the sensor in systems of technical diagnosis at the early stage of the ice appearing.

articleTitle: Modeling of input load's parameters of control system of wind power system
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the method and algorithm of modeling the dynamics of the load parameters which receive to the input of control system of wind power plant was implemented. Dependence of the dynamics of the input data of control system for the specific time intervals based on analysis of real data was received.

Author Keywords: modeling of input parameters of load

articleTitle: Effects of FCL on operation of SEF-DFIG in wind turbine systems during grid fault
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: During last decade, the concept of a variable speed wind turbine equipped with doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) has received increasing attention due to its noticeable advantages over other wind turbine generator concepts. New configuration of DFIG is single external feeding of DFIG (SEF-DFIG) where a rotor side converter (RSC) replaces the back to back variable frequency converter (VFC) in the conventional DFIG. The main issue of wind turbines that equipped DFIG and SEF-DFIG is the grid faults or low voltage ride through capability. In this paper, a new solution for uninterrupted operation of wind turbine driving a SEF-DFIG has been proposed during fault condition in the grid. A fault current limiter (FCL) is placed in series with the rotor circuit. During fault condition FCL enters a impedance in the rotor circuit to inhabit increasing of current in the rotor circuit. When the fault is cleared the FCL bypasses the impedance. A static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) has been applied for supplying required reactive power in faults and steady states. Capability and modeling accuracy of the proposed method confirmed with simulating a sample power system in PSCAD/EMTDC software.

Author Keywords: single external feeding doubly fed induction generator (SEF-DFIG)

articleTitle: Wavelet-neural network for detection signals from transverse cracks in the rail head
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper, the implementation of artificial neural network (ANN) for detection signals from transverse cracks in the rails is presented. As input parameters, this network uses the coefficients of continuous wavelet transform (CWT), which are obtained from the analysis of signals recorded during the magnetodynamic flaw detection of rails.

articleTitle: Estimating of computation time of parallel algorithm of computations of dynamic processes in GPU systems
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A parallel process of computation of dynamic processes is based on a diakoptic theory of the portioning of the system into the sub-systems, that are computed independent of each other, in the fixed time intervals. Every process is defined by the complexity of computation. This complexity is changed in the time of process of computations. These properties are utilized to implement computation in parallel systems. Currently the growth of parallel systems has been observed for several years. In this article, idea of GPU computations and parallel algorithms are presented. The results of computation on tested parallel system are shown and interpreted.

articleTitle: Macromodel of dynamics of the electric power generated by small hydroelectric power station based on interval data analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: An approach to constructing the macromodel of dynamics of electric power generated by Small HydroElectric Power Station (SHEPS) based on interval data analysis is presented in the paper. A new method the estimation of macromodel parameters is proposed. Unlike the existing ones it provides possibility to get the multiple estimations of parameters and also it has low computational complexity.

Author Keywords: interval system of linear algebraic equations

articleTitle: Diffraction by a strip with different boundary conditions on its surfaces
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A two-dimensional problem of electromagnetic wave diffraction by a plane strip with different boundary conditions on its surfaces is in the focus of our study. The diffracted field is expressed by an integral in terms of the induced electric and magnetic current densities. Applying the representation theorem for the scattering field, the problem is reduced to the solutions of the integral equations. Numerical solutions and high frequency asymptotics for the scattering field in the wave zone of the inclusion are presented.

articleTitle: The analysis of solid dielectrics nonlinear conductivity influence on a low-frequency electric field distribution in them
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of mathematical modeling of a strong electric field (EF) in a cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE), which conductivity is a nonlinear function of the field strength. The analysis of changes in the gain coefficients of EF and total current density increase near water micro-trees, occurring on separate conductive micro-inclusions.

articleTitle: Comparison of application features of static and differential parameters
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper discussed computational procedures for electromagnetic field analysis based on finite difference method and utilizing either static or differential parameters. The expressions for tensors of static and differential permeability and their derivatives in an arbitrary Cartesian frame have been received. It has been shown that computational procedure utilizing static parameters requires much more computational time than procedure utilizing differential parameters.

articleTitle: Dynamic models of epidemic — Preliminary study
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper considers the dynamic models of spreading the epidemic. The process is described by the set of differential equations. Two models of different complexity are analyzed and compared. The simplest one recognizes only three classes of individuals (susceptible, infected and recovering). The second one takes into account also the dynamic changes of the diseased individuals and quarantined. The results of numerical simulation of both models have been presented and compared.

articleTitle: The concept of using the tent structure as a measure of protection against lightning
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper was presented the concept of using the tent structure as a measure of protection against lightning. There are described technical assumptions for it structure with regard to used materials. There were calculated expected effects of influence high voltage and high current surges. Also high voltage and high current surge experiment set up and results were shown. Finally conclusions were drown.

articleTitle: Macromodeling as an alternative approach for electric power systems modeling using ATP and MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper the problems of electric power systems creation and their further adaptation to modern software tools is considered. The discrete mathematical macromodels of electric power systems and approaches for their creation based on experimental data are discussed.

articleTitle: Design of PM motor dedicated to longwall shearer advance drive
publicationTitle: 2015 16th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Results of permanent magnet synchronous motor design calculations are presented in the paper. This motor is proposed for the longwall shearer advance drive. The authors have described the advantages of permanent magnet motors, presented most common designs of rotors and explained field-circuital method which was used for electromagnetic circuit design.
